title: EtherPass - Decentralized Event Ticket Booking System
description:
EtherPass is a decentralized event ticket-booking system that lets users book tickets for events directly with their web3 wallet, using the blockchain to handle ticket ownership in a tamper-resistant way.

Its smart contracts are written in Solidity and developed with Truffle on Ethereum, accessed from the client via Web3.js and MetaMask. The application layer combines a React.js (Vite.js) frontend with a Nest.js backend and Turso DB.
